article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Khaafiq Myers had 17 points to lead Saint Joseph’s to an 84-65 victory over Wagner on Tuesday. Myers shot 5 of 12 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 7 from the free-throw line for the Hawks (5-0). BJ Ranson scored 16 points and added six rebounds. Sean Logan shot 6 of 8 from the field and 3 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Kareem Watson led the way for the Seahawks (1-4) with 18 points. Wagner also got 17 points from A.J. Rodriguez. Taj Bryant had 13 points. Saint Joseph’s took the lead with 18:14 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Logan led their team in scoring with 12 points to help put them up 45-27 at the break. Up next: Both teams next play Friday. Saint Joseph’s visits Drexel and Wagner squares off against Maryland on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
